sources.name: ls
peek
sources.cmd:
p=$HATCH_ARG
case "$p" in /*) ;; *) echo '@@err not an absolute path'; exit 0;; esac
[ -e "$p" ] || { echo '@@err no such file (it may have been moved or deleted)'; exit 0; }
st=$(stat -L -c '%s	%Y	%a	%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null) || { echo '@@err cannot read file information'; exit 0; }
printf '@@stat %s\n' "$st"
[ -f "$p" ] || { echo @@special; exit 0; }
[ -r "$p" ] || { echo '@@err permission denied'; exit 0; }
sz=$(printf '%s' "$st" | cut -f1)
d=$(file -b -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -c 200); [ -n "$d" ] && printf '@@desc %s\n' "$d"
l=$(printf '%s' "$p" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
case "$l" in *.png) m=image/png;; *.jpg|*.jpeg) m=image/jpeg;; *.gif) m=image/gif;; *.webp) m=image/webp;; *.svg) m=image/svg+xml;; *) m=;; esac
if [ -n "$m" ]; then
  if [ "$sz" -gt 2097152 ]; then echo @@bigimage; exit 0; fi
  echo "@@image $m"; echo @@body; base64 -w0 < "$p" 2>/dev/null || base64 < "$p" | tr -d '\n'; exit 0
fi
a=$(head -c 4096 -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | wc -c); b=$(head -c 4096 -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C tr -d '\000-\010\013\016-\032\034-\037\177' | wc -c)
if [ "$a" != "$b" ]; then echo @@binary; exit 0; fi
[ "$sz" -gt 65536 ] && echo @@trunc
echo @@text; echo @@body; head -c 65536 -- "$p" 2>/dev/null
true
